metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.3 · 2003 · Johnny English
metas.description: After a sudden attack on MI7, Johnny English, Britain's most confident, yet unintelligent spy, becomes Britain's only spy.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.3 · 2011 · Johnny English Reborn
metas.description: Johnny English goes up against international assassins hunting down Chinese Premier Xiang Ping.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.2 · 2018 · Johnny English Strikes Again
metas.description: After a cyber-attack reveals the identity of all of the active undercover agents in Britain, Johnny English is forced to come out of retirement to find the mastermind hacker.
